description: This Java source file defines the ImmutableEntry class, which implements an immutable key-value pair with additional matching logic, used within the mockserver project for handling request matching and comparison.

classes.name: ImmutableEntry
classes.description: An immutable key-value pair class with matching capabilities, used for request matching in mockserver.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Factory methods to create ImmutableEntry instances with either String or NottableString keys.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Checks if the key is optional.

methods.name: isNotted
methods.description: Checks if the key is marked as 'not'.

methods.name: isNotOptional
methods.description: Checks if the key is not optional.

methods.name: getLeft
methods.description: Returns the key part of the entry.

methods.name: getRight
methods.description: Returns the value part of the entry.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException as ImmutableEntry is immutable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the entry.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on regex matching of key and value, considering optional keys.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on key and value.

methods.name: listsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two lists of generic items are equal.

methods.name: listsEqualWithOptionals
methods.description: Checks if two lists of ImmutableEntry are equal, considering optional keys and regex matching.
